item.title: PeakBar 1.2.0
item.description:
### New
- **Updates from within the app.** PeakBar checks GitHub once a day for a new version. When there is one, you get a notification and an **Update** button on the card; one click downloads, verifies and installs it, then restarts PeakBar. Powered by [Sparkle](https://sparkle-project.org). - Settings: **Check for updates** with a **Check now** button, and **Notify when an update is available**. The back of the card also shows the version.
### Security
- Updates and the update feed are signed with an EdDSA key; unsigned or altered updates are refused.
### Note
- Version 1.1.1 and older have no updater: install this version once by hand, later versions arrive by themselves.
